crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s word came to him in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
Yahweh’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and…
Yahweh’s word that came to Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah…
For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:

people.name: Joel
people.line: A prophet of Judah and the author of the Book of Joel

translations.web: Yahweh’s word that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel.
translations.bsb: This is the word of the LORD that came to Joel son of Pethuel:
translations.kjv: The word of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
translations.asv: The word of Jehovah that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
